The L.A. riots deserve its place on this list... I was on my 2nd year in Community College... in Cerritos... I was at school from 6:30 am till 10 pm... taking classes at weird hours... I had a schedule that basically had me stuck there all day... during the day I had friends tell me stuff like... hey they found the cops not guilty... and then in the afternoon other news... when I left school and drove home I saw the night sky BRIGHT ORANGE... and thought what the hell!!!... I turn on the radio... there weren't cellphones back then... and then I hear  radio announcement saying things like LETS ALL CALM DOWN... LETS GET SOME SLEEP AND THINK WHAT WERE DOING...now I'm thinking what the hell is going on... I get off the freeway and people all over the streets burning things and yelling... I see fire trucks and ambulances blaring by..  I get home I live in Huntington Park which is predominantly hispanic neighborhood... but near watts and south central... my mom was scared to no end because once again there's no cellphones back then ... and her son was out in the city all day... never will forget the chaos of those days.
